skill.boardmix.name: Boardmix Whiteboard
skill.boardmix.description: Three routes: a sentence to the in-page AI, Mermaid to the product's own importer, real input on the page — each one confirmed with a screenshot.
skill.boardmix-canvas.name: Draw on the Canvas
skill.boardmix-canvas.description: Put structure on the canvas through the product's own Mermaid channel: stage the source with boardmix_diagram, paste it when asked, then prove it with a PNG. Only the six kinds it parses.
skill.boardmix-collaboration.name: Share and Collaborate
skill.boardmix-collaboration.description: Pick the permission tier, invite the right people, and run a review or workshop without hitting an organisation limit.
skill.boardmix-ai.name: Generate with Boardmix AI
skill.boardmix-ai.description: Deliver a written prompt into the in-page AI composer and send it only when asked; generations spend the user's points and are verified by screenshot.
skill.boardmix-io.name: Import and Export
skill.boardmix-io.description: Bring PPT / PDF / Mermaid into a board or export one: Mermaid goes through boardmix_diagram, and the watermark and size limits are stated up front.
